source_comparison: Overlay native files retain the PR head implementation. Native additions from current main are WorldRealism.cpp and WorldSmoke.cpp from merged brick PR #44.
startup_note: Two startup-only attempts were stopped during concurrent engine builds before assertions. Final overlay launch used a Saved-only copy with an 8-to-30-minute watchdog and the same original project path. Exact reversal verified the input/assertion script is otherwise unchanged. The repository wrapper was not modified.
capture_note: Default capture includes a transient engine shader-preparation indicator; hidden/settings captures and later gait capture were reviewed after startup. Final logs have zero error/fallback/overflow matches.
prior_counts_scope: Prior independent PR validation, not included in the fresh 180 total
